questions.stem:
SCIENCE PASSAGE 7: Battery Voltage at Different Temperatures
Students placed identical batteries in temperature-controlled chambers for 30 minutes. They then connected each battery to the same resistor and recorded voltage immediately and after 5 minutes. Each temperature condition used a new battery from the same package.

Which choice correctly identifies the independent variable(s) in the investigation?
F) voltage under load
G) resistor, battery type, and conditioning time
H) battery temperature
J) the numerical labels printed on the graph

options.B: resistor, battery type, and conditioning time
options.C: battery temperature
options.D: the numerical labels printed on the graph

questions.explanation: Independent variables are intentionally varied or used to define treatment conditions.

questions.stem:
SCIENCE MATERIAL SET 4
Students tested how water temperature affected the time required for a tablet to dissolve. They used identical tablets, 103 mL of water in each cup, and stirred each cup at the same rate.

TABLE 1
Temperature (°C) | Dissolving time (s)
10 | 32
20 | 24
30 | 19
40 | 15

Trial 2 repeated the procedure with twice the water volume. Researcher 1 claims that higher temperature increases particle motion and therefore decreases dissolving time. Researcher 2 agrees that temperature matters but claims that stirring rate is the dominant factor whenever stirring is not controlled.

Which change would introduce a confounding variable?
A) using identical tablets
B) using the same water volume
C) using a faster stirring rate only at 40°C
D) measuring all times in seconds

options.C: using a faster stirring rate only at 40°C

questions.explanation: The keyed response follows the material and directly targets 识别设计缺陷或混杂变量.
